S10-C's build decisions with the measured facts

limitations: **Nothing about a real mixture.** Every expectation is a closed form of `wilson-ig-v1` evaluated at 50 digits. A column or flash that matches it computes the model; whether the model describes methanol, ethanol and water is S10's validation question (S10 §9.6), and VAL-3's latent-heat miss (methanol +5.72 %) is carried, not cured (§7.3).
**The verification and test-built record sets are fixtures.** `S10-VER-ref-v1`, its Λ ≡ 1 copy and its narrowed-domain copy (§5.1) are invented; no number from them is evidence about a substance.

**No column claim beyond C-MW and C-EW at their registered roots.** Local regularity (σ_min, §5.5) is shown; uniqueness of the MESH root, convergence from other openings, ternary columns, other specification kinds, Stage B on a registered solve and flowsheet use are not.
**T5 is proved for binaries only.** For three or more flowing components the band route converges or ends typed; an accepted answer is correct (T4), but the uniqueness of `T(β)` is not claimed.
**The convergence of the constant-β point is measured, not proved** (§7.2). Outside the scan, the cap and the typed failure are the only guarantee.

**The G7 tolerances are an acceptance image, not an accuracy claim.** They bound what a correct solver may return after stopping inside the kind tolerances; they do not say how accurate a column result is for any other purpose.

**Self-generated outputs are not used.** No expectation here comes from the implementation. The `measured` class of the YAML is a binary64 transcription in the generator, used only to measure floors and iteration counts.

`wilson-ig-v1` has library-level support for the column (solve_column), the PH kernel (ph_state) and the orchestrator's single-phase admissibility (S10-C); flowsheet selection is not offered: it stays library-only, not in SELECTABLE_BASES (U02; the T08 envelope's LIBRARY_ONLY_PROVIDERS keeps it). This restates the earlier S10 manifests' harvested 'no column, PH-flash or flowsheet claim' for the column and the PH kernel; those harvest entries are not rewritten (HG(b), R-617; docs/S10C_DECISIONS.md W5-3).

T1–T5 are certified for the committed record sets only (records.real.sha256, records.verification.sha256) and the test-built copies of spec §5.1, on their declared T domains; a record file admitted under WILSON-IG-ref-v1 or S10-VER-ref-v1 has P1–P3 unchecked, and an admission-time check is deferred to the package that makes the provider selectable in flowsheets (spec §11 E4, R-781).

requirements is empty: neither the design note nor the specification assigns S10-C a D/A requirement id. S10-C has no package entry in docs/requirements.yaml because the frozen ledger schema admits only ^[PKTMSR][0-9]{2}$ package ids; the ledger records it in a comment under S10 (docs/S10C_DECISIONS.md W5-2).

scripts/gate.sh and CI on x86-64 and aarch64 (§6 G10) were not run by this generator (they run once before merge into main); S10C.gate and S10C.ci are unsupported here. G9's wall times were measured in WO-4 (docs/S10C_DECISIONS.md, WO-4 run log; review R-780), not here.

Review: the design lane's one reviewer pass on WO-1 to WO-4 (docs/reviews/S10C-review.md) set one must-fix (F1: G3 against its registered references, A60, A61) before reviewed; WO-6 carries it (tests/test_s10c_band_references.py). Whether it is closed is the reviewer's to judge: the review fields stay pending and the human numerical and process-model review is pending; this manifest claims neither.
